base_url.description: Full Linear GraphQL endpoint URL override for tests or proxies.

api_key.description: Linear personal API key, sent as a bare Authorization header (no Bearer prefix).

access_token.description: Linear OAuth access token, sent as a Bearer Authorization header. Takes priority when both secrets are configured.

auth_type.description: Set to oauth or oauth2.0 to send api_key with a Bearer prefix instead of the default bare personal API key header.
